income.howText: We count income only: card profit (paid and still accruing) and partner rewards. Card purchase prices and deposits are not income. “On invested” is income divided by the total price of your cards, including those already paid out. Daily income is recorded in dollars at the rate at accrual time; older days without that record use the current rate.

compare.howText: Each asset is scored on six metrics from 0 to 10: yield, growth potential, simplicity, liquidity, entry threshold and safety. The platform sets the scores from public data and product rules and reviews them at least quarterly. We show Tyrex’s weak sides too — for example, liquidity because of the cooling period.
compare.note: This is the platform’s own assessment, not an independent rating. Any investment involves risk.

forecast.howText: Card income accrues in BTC at the series rate, so its dollar value rises or falls with the rate. The card’s purchase price is returned in dollars and doesn’t depend on the rate. We assume income and the monthly top-up go into new cards every month. Boosters, bonuses and partner income are not included — they will be added once they exist in the product.
forecast.disclaimer: Hypothetical calculation for illustration only. It is not a forecast or a guarantee of income: actual results may differ, including losses.

yield.title: Yield
yield.full: How much the capital grows in one year with this instrument, in % per year.

growth.title: Growth potential
growth.short: Chance of the asset price rising
growth.full: Long-term potential of the asset to gain value, regardless of payouts.

passive.title: Simplicity
passive.short: How hard it is to manage
passive.full: Knowledge and effort required. A high score means the asset needs little expertise or involvement.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.short: How fast it turns into cash
liquidity.full: How quickly you can withdraw funds without losing value. For Tyrex: stopping a card starts a cooling period before funds return.

entry.title: Entry threshold
entry.short: How much money you need to start
entry.full: Financial accessibility. The higher the score, the less money you need to start.

safety.title: Safety
safety.full: Overall reliability estimate. A higher score means a lower chance of drawdown. Any investment carries risk.

Real Estate.label: Real estate
Real Estate.conclusion: Real estate holds value well but needs a large starting capital and is slow to sell. Tyrex starts from the price of one card; income follows the series rate, which the platform sets and may change.

Bank Deposit.label: Bank
Bank Deposit.conclusion: Bank deposits are regulated and insured, but the rate is often close to inflation. Tyrex series rates are higher, but there is no deposit insurance and the rate may change.

S&P 500.label: Stocks
S&P 500.conclusion: Stocks have grown over the long run but are volatile and require market knowledge. Tyrex accrues income at the series rate without active management.

Gold.label: Gold
Gold.conclusion: Gold preserves value but generates no passive income. Tyrex accrues income daily at the tariff rate, but it is a different risk profile.

Business.label: Business
Business.conclusion: Your own business can bring high income but takes full involvement and carries high risk. Tyrex requires no involvement after purchase and start.

Funds.label: Funds
Funds.conclusion: Funds are easy to hold but charge fees and give no control over assets. In Tyrex you see accruals for each card directly.

Staking.label: Staking
Staking.conclusion: Staking pays a modest rate and often locks coins for a period. Tyrex also has a lock: after you stop a card, a cooling period runs before funds return.

Mining.label: Mining
Mining.conclusion: Mining requires buying hardware and paying for electricity. Tyrex cards need no equipment; income follows the series rate.

Trading.label: Trading
Trading.conclusion: Trading can bring high profit but also a full loss of the deposit, and needs constant attention. Tyrex is passive and accrues at the series rate.

Altcoins.label: Altcoins
Altcoins.conclusion: Altcoins can rise many times or fall to zero. Tyrex cards are tied to BTC and accrue at the series rate; their dollar value follows the BTC rate.

Bots.label: Bots
Bots.conclusion: Trading bots automate trades but can lose money in unstable markets. Tyrex accrues income at the tariff rate without trading settings.

Signals.label: Signals
Signals.conclusion: Signals depend on someone else's analysis and manual execution. Tyrex requires no trading decisions after start.
